_comment: Hand-maintained. `source` is the value stored on books (Notion display name). `name` is what the site shows. `slug` is the URL segment and must never change once a theme page ships. Order is EDITORIAL, not by count.

themes.name: Business & Finance
themes.intro: Markets, money, and the institutions that move both — told mostly through the people who built, broke, or bet against them.

themes.name: Personal Growth & Leadership
themes.intro: How people get better at hard things, and how they get others to follow. Practical more often than inspirational.

themes.name: Psychology & Mind
themes.intro: Attention, memory, trauma, habit, and belief — the machinery underneath the decisions people think they reasoned their way to.

themes.name: Tech & Future
themes.intro: Silicon, software, and the companies steering both — plus the harder question of what happens next.

themes.name: History & Foreign Affairs
themes.intro: How the current arrangement of the world got made, and the wars, treaties, and intelligence failures that shaped it.

themes.name: Society & Culture
themes.intro: Class, race, place, and the slow-moving forces that decide who gets what in America.

themes.name: Memoir & Biography
themes.intro: One life at a time — usually someone close enough to power to describe how it actually operates.

themes.name: Crime & Justice
themes.intro: Courts, cartels, cons, and the long gap between what the law says and what it does.

themes.name: Politics & Power
themes.intro: The largest shelf here by a wide margin — how power is won, held, abused, and occasionally checked.

themes.name: Theology & Faith
themes.intro: Belief as a personal question and as a political one, and the places those two stop being separable.
